committee.sub: Morning brief · Thursday 5 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: The A$600 promo credit is now exhausted (creditRemainingExGst $0) after 85 raw paid clicks, averaging about $6.97 ex-GST each (spendExGst $592.60), with ads.conversionsLast7 still at 0.

On the test landing page the ask-first CTA has drawn 19 clicks since launch versus zero review bookings (review_cta_click 0), matching the question-first design; raw paid clicks have now reached 85, past the 75-click checkpoint, with qualified counts still held in Chris's manual log.

One new unverified enquiry came through this week (generate_lead 1, formStartsLast7 1), separate from the 23 September wholesale food enquiry, and needs grading against the qualified rule (real business, repeatable admin, named system).

Organic Search sessions fell to 6 this week from 9 prior, and Search Console data only runs through 2 Nov, two days behind yesterday, where the top page (/simpro-xero-integration.html) drew 110 impressions but just 1 click at position 15, with core SimPRO queries still ranking at positions 61 and 90; AI Assistant referrals remain at zero for the second week running.

actions.text: Raw paid clicks have reached 85, past the 75-click checkpoint: check the test log now, if relevant clicks are 75 or more with zero qualified enquiries the red flag applies.
The A$600 promo credit is fully spent (creditRemainingExGst $0): pause paid search unless cost per qualified enquiry is A$480 or less and at least one qualified prospect has booked a review.
Check the Formspree and Cal.com email for this week's unverified enquiry (generate_lead 1) to confirm its source and grade it against the qualified rule in the test log.
The landing page is past click 25 and stays frozen on headline, offer and CTAs unless something is broken.
Logo and image assets for the serving ad groups (Agency, Job Intake) are still outstanding.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success; these need updating to match current site stats.
